title: Upgrade Group
description: UI component for displaying and selecting from a group of upgrades.
content:
Upgrade Group

UI component for presenting upgrade choices and handling player selection.

Component UI

Schema

JSON
"upgradeGroup": {
  "upgrades": [],
  "maxChoices": 0,
  "randomize": true
}

Description

The UpgradeGroup component creates a UI panel that presents a set of upgrade options for the player to choose from. It is commonly used for level-up screens, power-up selections, and skill trees. The component supports randomized selection from a pool of available upgrades and limits the number of choices displayed at once.

Fields

NameTypeDescription
upgradesstring[]Array of upgrade entity IDs available in this group.
maxChoicesintMaximum number of upgrade options to display at once.
randomizeboolWhether to randomly select upgrades from the pool each time the group is shown.

Example

JSON
{
  "components": {
    "upgradeGroup": {
      "upgrades": ["upgrade_speed", "upgrade_damage", "upgrade_health", "upgrade_shield"],
      "maxChoices": 3,
      "randomize": true
    }
  }
}
